acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Wraiths family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Death Sovereign, T5, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Hollow-Court Boundary Monarch (Sovereign) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two wind construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: A regal footless void housed in ornate hollow armor, carrying a scythe of condensed frozen smoke, wearing a robe like a sparse night sky, and followed by a court of lesser shades aligned to four visible armor seals.

Signature mechanic: Last Court: four ornate armor seals ring the Sovereign's empty cuirass and align to funeral arches around the arena. The Eye seal calls Shades to align across one arch; the Chain seal sends Haunts through paired thresholds; the Blade seal gives a Wraith a remote scythe edge; and the Crown seal spreads a Crowned Specter's cloak between arches. The Sovereign lifts its frozen-smoke scythe toward one seal while a court of lesser shades forms a procession to the matching arch. Striking the exposed seal during that command shatters its arch and removes the phase. After two seals break, the hollow armor opens and the void wears the surviving plates as two asymmetric anchors, cycling only surviving commands with shorter, clearer routes.
battlefieldDuty: Command a four-seal funeral court from hollow armor, composing alignment, threshold, borrowed-edge, and black-tide phases before abandoning broken regalia for a simpler exposed void form.
constructionDimensions: The T1 Shade keeps only two cold eye points and a transient vapor outline, with fine vapor vanes radiating from each point to show the next pressure direction. T2–T5 become deliberate pressure instruments through vane-cut shrouds, hollow chain whistles, asymmetric cloak sails, and crown or armor channels that point toward the next emergence without adding feet or solid flesh.

The T1 Shade draws its transient vapor outline into one directional streamer while the eye gap remains a visible still center between the two points. T2–T5 expose force through taut cloth, chain arcs, debris streamlines, compression ahead of the spectral blade, and a still center around the hood, crown, or armor seal.
counterplay: Read the procession and familiar lower-form tell, move away from the chosen arch, then strike the outward-facing armor seal while the scythe is committed; each shattered seal removes one command, one arena arch, and one plate from the void phase. Affinity signal: For the T1 Shade, eye alignment points the vapor streamer while the eye gap stays a still center; crossing its lee or striking the gap breaks the pass. T2–T5 snap tatters into one direction while the hood, crown, or cuirass seal becomes still enough to attack.
forbiddenTreatments: Palette-only wind treatment without vane construction, chain behavior, and directional displacement
Glow-only wind treatment without readable force direction or a still center
Transparency alone presented as Wind despite matching Normal incorporeality
Omnidirectional vapor that hides the selected surface or spectral anchor
identityInvariants: A hooded or robed humanoid upper body becomes progressively defined while the lower body always trails into smoke or cold vapor without visible feet.
Black, charcoal, deep indigo, and ash grey carry one cold eye accent in pale blue, white, or sickly green; this family-native cold light is not an elemental affinity by itself.
Smoke, tattered shroud-cloth, cold vapor, rusted chain, and hollow armor preserve incorporeality through negative space and incomplete edges.
Chains, funeral shrouds, spectral crowns, and localized rings of source-native frost become anchors that explain when and where an otherwise incorporeal form can be opposed.
Escalation condenses a faint outline into a sharply defined regal silhouette while retaining a vapor tail, empty interior, and one readable anchor for every phase-through action.
telegraph: One armor seal turns toward the viewer, the scythe condenses along that seal's arch, stars in the night-sky robe stop moving, and the lesser-shade court forms a single-file route to the selected station.
